description: Digital-partition testbenches under digital/: every Icarus Verilog testbench (tb_*.v), bench runner (run_tests.sh, run_mutation.sh, run_coupled*.sh, sim_one.sh), bench parameter generator (params.py) and the digital/ci scripts. cold_start is the 14-step serial regression driver digital/ci/run_digital_regressions.sh, which also runs spi-crossing/run_tests.sh. It needs iverilog (pinned v13_0, commit dfeee909ed9f20b4870dd93423156c0170c0e1ff, built by digital/ci/install_iverilog.sh) and python3, so it is local_only: --check carries the committed outcome rather than re-running it, and .github/workflows/digital-regressions.yml runs it on every PR. Behavioral RTL only: no synthesis or gate-level replay exists. Re-attest locally with: klt signoff --attest 9 --inventory attest/item9.digital.json -o attest/item9.digital.envelope.json

pdk.name: none
pdk.revision: not applicable: the digital cold start is behavioral RTL under iverilog and consumes no PDK

tools.python3: system python3 from the ubuntu runner image (not pinned by digital-regressions.yml)
